item: The Diagnostics manifest's machine block records which XML driver feedparser uses in the process (feed_xml): preferred list, and drv_libxml2 as absent, found_not_loaded or loaded
refs: R179 (Q56 = D); coordinator 17 Oct plan OK; PR #1443
summary: feedparser asks xml.sax.make_parser for libxml2's SAX driver first, so where the libxml2 Python bindings import it parses feeds outside the extraction lock, and nobody knows how many installs have them. machine.feed_xml names it: preferred (feedparser's own list) and drv_libxml2 = loaded (the module is in sys.modules: a feed parse of this process used it, inferred), absent (no module of that name on the import path: expat), found_not_loaded (a file of that name is on the path; no parse has reached it, or its import failed: the value does not say which). Read without importing the driver or calling make_parser (that would load libxml2 from the diagnostics thread outside the lock), sys.modules before find_spec (find_spec raises ValueError for a spec-less module). MACHINE_RECORD_VERSION 2. Paid for inside the block: not_here 166 to 96 B and environment.method 92 to 61 B, so the widest section (101 B) fits the UNCOMPRESSED manifest's pin of 258 B with no slack. Measured against main's block, raw / DEFLATE level 9, in bytes: absent -12 / -10, loaded -12 / -9, found_not_loaded -2 / -6, feedparser unreadable -2 / -13, find_spec fails (ValueError) +25 / -3; that last shape reads 128 B in the pin's own measure, 27 B over it, and cannot arise while sys.modules is read first except in a race. Known wrong reading, stated in the docstring and pinned: a None placed in sys.modules for the name reads absent while make_parser re-raises. Tests: a real driver file that leaves a marker when imported (found_not_loaded without the marker, loaded after a real feedparser.parse), the absent control with a real parse, the spec-less module, the list, an unreadable feedparser, and the bytes pin; ten mutants fail.
